_source: Curated from the Serpent's Gaze community wiki (https://serpents-gaze.fandom.com/, CC-BY-SA): 'In-level Interactables' and 'Post-Boss Interactions' pages, plus in-repo game-file research. Game-authored unlock strings always win over these.
_canonicalUntaggedWeaponsNote: Weapon trees contain internal tier/cut variants with identical family masteries (e.g. Morningstar duplicates Mace of the Maiden). Only these untagged weapons are real, per the wiki's weapon roster; other untagged trees are dropped.
_hiddenTagsNote: Content whose game-authored text describes the Doom mechanic, which has been removed from the game. The seeds that used to grant Doom were rewritten (Item.Seed.DoomHit now reads 'Sanguine', SecondaryDoomAoe reads 'Blight/Rot') but these two were not, so the game still ships descriptions for a stat that no longer exists. Hidden rather than reworded, because inventing replacement text would be a guess.
